subject: Re: DPA — cross-border transfer & KMS requirement causing hold
body:
--- Message 1: Lisa Chung (GreenBank Legal) to neha_kapoor, procurement@greenbank.com — Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:02 PST
From: Lisa Chung <lisa.chung@greenbank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@greenbank.com
Cc: 
Date: Tue, Nov 24, 2026 at 09:02 AM -0800
Subject: DPA redlines and KMS requirement — hold on PO

Neha — thanks for the quick demo last week. Procurement ran the DPA past Legal and Security and we have a few non-negotiable items before we can issue a PO:

- Our security team requires a Customer-held KMS option for keys used to encrypt customer data at rest (they flagged this in the attached redlines).
- We require explicit cross-border transfer language (SCCs or equivalent) for EU-origin data; the redline suggests SCC + Appendix.
- We need the full subprocessor list and a commitment to 30 days' notice before onboarding any new subprocessor.

Attached: GreenBank_DPA_Redlines_v1.pdf

Procurement has put GreenBank’s onboarding on hold until Legal signs off on the exception (if any). If Redwood cannot commit to the KMS option, we will need an exec-level risk acceptance from your side. Can you advise expected turnaround? We are targeting a December 6 go-live for this product if the contract completes this week.

Regards,
Lisa Chung
General Counsel, GreenBank Financial
lisa.chung@greenbank.com

--- Message 2: Neha Kapoor (Redwood) reply to Lisa + internal loop — Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:15 PST
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Chung <lisa.chung@greenbank.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, Nov 24, 2026 at 11:15 AM -0800
Subject: Re: DPA redlines and KMS requirement — hold on PO

Thanks Lisa — appreciate the clear list. Short answers up front:
- We have provided our current subprocessor list (attached) and can commit to 30 days' notice for new subprocessors as a contractual commitment.
- We do not currently offer customer-managed KMS for hosted tenants in our standard Hosted API tier; we do support Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) for Dedicated/private deployments behind a customer-managed HSM, which is typically handled via a separate addendum/SOW.

I’m looping Legal (Priyom) and CS (Marissa) so we can: 1) review the redlines, 2) propose a pragmatic interim path (DocuSignable DPA + KMS addendum SOW), and 3) provide a timeline for exec risk acceptance if required.

Can you confirm whether GreenBank will accept SCCs as the primary transfer mechanism while we work through the KMS addendum? That would allow procurement to proceed on the DPA.

Attachments: Redwood_Subprocessors_2026-11.xlsx

— Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

--- Message 3: Priyom Das (Redwood Legal) to Neha, Lisa — Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:40 PST
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Lisa Chung <lisa.chung@greenbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, Nov 25, 2026 at 10:40 AM -0800
Subject: Re: DPA redlines and KMS requirement — legal note

Lisa/Neha — I reviewed GreenBank's redlines. Quick summary from Legal and Risk: 

- Subprocessors: acceptable — we confirm the attached master list and can add a 30-day notice clause.
- Cross-border transfers: we can include SCCs (standard approach) plus an Appendix documenting transfer mechanisms. That is contractually straightforward.
- KMS / Customer-held key: this is the stickiest item. Offering BYOK for Hosted customers requires platform changes and a security review; it is not standard for our hosted offering and would need Risk & CTO approval.

If GreenBank cannot accept the SCC + Appendix and requires KMS at execution, we will need escalation to risk execs for an exception. Typical timeline: 3–7 business days for an initial risk triage, and up to 10 business days for a formal signed exception decision depending on calendar. I have attached a short Risk_Triage_Summary with next steps.

Proposed pragmatic path to avoid delaying procurement: 1) Execute the DPA with SCCs now (DocuSign link below), 2) Add a discrete KMS addendum (SOW) that we commit to evaluate and deliver (or provide a formal exception) within 10 business days. If GreenBank wants a firm timeline in the contract, we can add milestone language in the addendum.

Attachments: Risk_Triage_Summary.pdf
DocuSign (proposed DPA v3): https://www.docusign.net/12345abcdef

— Priyom Das
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com

--- Message 4: Marissa Cole (Redwood CS Lead) internal escalation to Neha/Priyom/Karthik — Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:30 PST
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, Nov 26, 2026 at 09:30 AM -0800
Subject: GreenBank — escalate for exec risk acceptance if needed

Team — GreenBank is a material strategic account (see HubSpot deal). Procurement has paused onboarding and is pressing for either immediate DPA signature or an exec-level risk acceptance. Sales notes: product go-live target Dec 6. If we let this slip we risk losing momentum (and potential Q4 revenue).

Requesting the following ASAP:
- Priyom: if KMS exception is necessary, please escalate to Risk VP (Karthik) for sign-off and provide an estimated decision date.
- Karthik: please review the Risk_Triage_Summary and advise whether a written exec acceptance is feasible within 5 business days. If not, propose an interim mitigation (e.g., controlled deployment, limited data residency SLA, or billing offset).

If we can get a documented interim mitigation we can keep procurement moving and sign the main DPA via DocuSign this week.

— Marissa
VP Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

--- Message 5: Neha Kapoor to Lisa + procurement — Sat, 28 Nov 2026 15:47 PST
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Chung <lisa.chung@greenbank.com>, procurement@greenbank.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, Nov 28, 2026 at 03:47 PM -0800
Subject: Re: DPA redlines and KMS requirement — next steps and proposed path to sign

Lisa — thanks for patience and for surfacing the key items. Short update and proposal that should keep your procurement moving while we finalize Risk review:

1) Execute the DPA now (DocuSign link below) with SCCs for cross-border transfers and the 30-day subprocessors notice clause — this addresses the majority of redlines.
2) Parallel track: Redwood will deliver a KMS addendum SOW or a formal written exec risk acceptance within 10 business days of DPA execution. If we cannot offer BYOK for Hosted, we will document the technical constraints and provide a timeline for Dedicated offering options.
3) As a gesture to bridge the gap we will commit to: a) a 99.9% data residency SLA for EU-scoped workloads (where applicable) and b) a one-time professional services credit if a dedicated KMS implementation is later required and billed.

DocuSign link to the proposed DPA v3 (incorporates SCC language + subprocessor notice): https://www.docusign.net/12345abcdef

Deadline ask: Can GreenBank sign the DPA by COB Thursday, Dec 2? If we do not have a signed DPA by then we will need to pause provisioning to align with contract governance. If you need an immediate written exec acceptance instead of a KMS addendum, please indicate and we will escalate accordingly.

Attachments referenced: Redwood_Subprocessors_2026-11.xlsx, Risk_Triage_Summary.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

— Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

On Sat, Nov 28, 2026 at 09:32 AM Lisa Chung <lisa.chung@greenbank.com> wrote:
> Neha — appreciate the update. Procurement can accept SCCs as an interim measure but Security is adamant about KMS for production; they require written exec acceptance if KMS cannot be provided.
> 
> I will review the DocuSign DPA and aim to respond by Monday.
> 
> Lisa
> GC, GreenBank

--- End of thread
